---
title: Encrypted portable storage
---

Encrypted USB drive/disk or USB flash drive (USB stick).

::: {.description}

You can order a drive or disk via the Order accessories form found in the service portal (link below).

Please note that it is highly recommended to always use encryption with portable storage, even if your data is classified as low.

[More info](https://services.vu.nl/esc?id=emp_taxonomy_topic&topic_id=868f521397cf09d0e553359fe153af5b)
